objective: Backlog B2 of docs/RESEARCH_GOALS.md, taken up at the owner's go-ahead (2026-11-08, 'Yes, let's do B1, growth as a law and also B2'): the first concrete step toward G15, the owner's picture of a point with a strength like charge moving through a learned network of knots, with learning orienting the logic to guide it to a resolution. On the Kasteleyn-signed knot spheres, the point is the forced dissonance (the violated line that no change of state removes) and learning is changing signs. Decide (1) whether one re-signing always moves the forced dissonance out of the states and into the law as two even faces, wherever they sit; (2) whether re-signings made only where dissonance is seen can carry it to any chosen line or face, and what a closed learning walk does to the state; (3) whether a local rule with a target signal does so, and how the number of states consistent with the law depends on where its two even faces sit. Serves the learning program and G15; standalone value relative to the nearest known work: the monomer-dimer and worm-algorithm picture of honeycomb dimers (Fisher-Stephenson 1963; Sandvik-Moessner 2006) and Ciucu's electrostatics of holes in lozenge tilings, carried to the knot's own law on a closed sphere, where the dissonance is forced.
status: Complete 2026-11-07: on Kasteleyn knot spheres one sign change at the forced dissonance always moves it out of the states and into the law as two even faces, which can sit anywhere (every simplicial sphere; Euler and Hall), and every line is the violated line of exactly 2 N(T) flat states, N(T)^2 = det(B B^T)/e2(colour classes); with the state fixed, sign changes made only at the dissonance carry it from any line to any line, and a closed learning walk is a block change of state. On the octahedral spheres a rule seeing one even face's lines and a target distance reached 2,399 of 2,400 targets; the halves repel like equal two-dimensional charges (count ~ distance^(1/2)) and a learner keeping the most states parks them on corners (150 of 150 runs). Continue, selected: learning in handles (backlog B6), awaiting the owner's go-ahead.
stop_rule: Stop when re-signing, steering and the local rule are settled on the octahedral knot spheres K_2-K_6 (by proof where possible, else by computation with controls), or a start is found from which no rule acting only at the dissonance can reach some target.
title: Steering the knot sphere's dissonance by re-signing
